title: Averaged Annealed Markov Chains Achieve the Algorithmic Threshold for Tensor PCA, Part I: Glauber Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.16705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the tensor principal components analysis (tensor PCA) problem, we are asked to recover an unknown vector in $\{\pm1\}^N$ from a noisy observation of its $k$-th tensor power, for a fixed $k\ge3$. Tensor PCA exhibits a well-studied information-computation gap: global algorithms such as spectral methods and sum-of-squares work above an algorithmic threshold, below which we know matching lower bounds (against these and some other restricted models of computation). In contrast, local algorithms such as Markov chains were only known to succeed from a random initialization at a polynomially larger signal-to-noise ratio, and were believed to be inferior to global algorithms for tensor PCA. We show that Glauber dynamics, when supplemented with annealing and ergodic averaging, achieves polynomial-time strong recovery above the algorithmic threshold from a uniformly random initialization, demonstrating that local Markov chains can succeed all

translated_title: 平均化退火马尔可夫链达到张量PCA的算法阈值，第一部分：Glauber动力学
translated_abstract: 在张量主成分分析（张量PCA）问题中，我们需要从一个未知向量的k次张量幂的含噪观测中恢复该向量，其中向量取自{±1}^N，k≥3为固定整数。张量PCA表现出一个已被广泛研究的信息-计算鸿沟：谱方法和平方和等全局算法在某个算法阈值之上可以成功运行，而在该阈值以下，我们知道针对这些算法以及某些其他受限计算模型的匹配下界。相比之下，马尔可夫链等局部算法此前仅在信噪比高出多项式倍时才被证明能从随机初始化成功，并且人们普遍认为它们在张量PCA问题上劣于全局算法。我们证明，Glauber动力学在辅以退火和遍历平均之后，能够从均匀随机初始化出发，在算法阈值之上实现多项式时间的强恢复，这表明局部马尔可夫链可以……
tldr: 通过结合退火与遍历平均的Glauber动力学，局部马尔可夫链能够从随机初始化出发，在算法阈值之上对张量PCA实现多项式时间强恢复，从而颠覆了局部算法劣于全局算法的传统认知。
en_tdlr: Glauber dynamics enhanced with annealing and ergodic averaging achieves polynomial-time strong recovery for tensor PCA above the algorithmic threshold from random initialization, overturning the belief that local Markov chains are inferior to global algorithms.
